summary: Tested the new DYNAMIC emission record schema (dynamic_field_values + outputs). Backend API layer is fully compliant — 5/5 pytest cases pass: create stores dynamic_field_values and outputs, is_override/justification persist, list returns qty from dynamic_field_values and co2/ch4/n2o/co2e from outputs, update round-trips overrides, delete works. Frontend Add-flow wizard structure works. Frontend Edit flow has SEVERAL BUGS: (a) Reporting Month shows 'undefined NaN' (pre-existing, unresolved from iter 61); (b) Only qty populates on Edit — cv, density, ef_quantity come back EMPTY even though audit-log/calc engine returned them, so override checkboxes open UNCHECKED with empty values; (c) Calculated Emissions panel in Edit dialog shows 0.00 tCO2/tCO2e while the Calculation Details pane directly below shows real numbers (672.21/0.027/0.005); (d) Two existing emission records in DB have dynamic_field_values={} and outputs={}, causing Emissions list to show Quantity=0 kg and 0.0000 tCO2e for every row; (e) Hydration error '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' persists in the edit dialog's Radix Select.

integration_issues.issue: All existing rows render Quantity=0 kg, CO2=0.0000, CH4=0.0000, N2O=0.0000, CO2e=0.0000. Root cause: the two persisted records (1d1dcfc7..., a940bff9...) have dynamic_field_values={} and outputs={} in Mongo. Backend stored them that way — i.e. the UI Add/Update flow that saved these records did NOT send dynamic_field_values/outputs, or sent empty dicts. Our pytest-created records saved dynamic_field_values and outputs correctly via the API, so the bug is in the Add/Edit form serialization (frontend), not in the backend model.

critical_code_review_comments: Emissions.js is 4500+ lines — still not split despite iter 61's comment. Extract EditEmissionDialog, AddEmissionDialog, EmissionCard and useAuditLogPopulate.

Edit-dialog population hook only handles `qty`. It must iterate every variable in the calc-engine form-config and populate from (1) record.dynamic_field_values, (2) audit-log inputs, (3) audit-log context — in that precedence — otherwise users cannot edit a record without re-entering all numeric inputs.

Add/Edit serialization: verify EmissionEntryForm.handleSubmit and Emissions.js handleSubmit both build dynamic_field_values keyed by form-config variable_name and include outputs (from calc-engine response) before POST/PUT. The two existing UI-created records in Mongo show these are currently empty {}.
Backend emission model is clean. Convenience accessors (co2_emissions, etc.) are derived from outputs — backend code is fine. No changes needed there.

Reproduce by opening Edit on any existing record and inspecting the network PUT payload. (3) Reporting Month 'undefined NaN' bug also still open.
rca of the issue: Edit dialog pre-fill: fetchAuditLogAndPopulate maps audit_log.inputs[].variable -> value only for keys present in inputMap. If form-config lists cv/density/ef_quantity as fields but the audit log exposes them only via `context` (derived from fuel DB, not user input), the population code does not copy them into dynamicFieldValues, leaving the inputs blank. When the user then saves, handleSubmit writes those blanks back into dynamic_field_values, producing the observed dynamic_field_values={} on persisted records. Fix: treat context values the same as inputs for population, and respect fuel-DB-sourced fields (mark read-only or tick the 'Override' checkbox only when user edits the value).
